sources.title: UdgamLabs/Udgam-384M-Chat-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 384M-parameter English model for on-device tool calling, trained from scratch by UdgamLabs. It is a decoder-only transformer compatible with the Gemma 4 architecture (Gemma4ForCausalLM), so it runs unmodified in Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, MLX and 🤗 transformers.
